pure-announcement.rationale: It is a technique explainer with working code, not a product, release, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: retrieval-augmented-generation covers the Lewis et al. architecture; HyDE is a specific query-transformation technique (embed a generated hypothetical answer instead of the query) a reader of that concept has not seen.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The mechanism is reproducible from the included code, and the underlying approach traces to the published HyDE work the article paraphrases.

durability.rationale: The core claim — question and answer embeddings occupy different geometries, so embedding a hypothetical answer makes the search answer-to-answer — is a mechanism-level insight that stays true regardless of which embedding model or LLM is fashionable in twelve months.

actionability.rationale: It gives the one-function delta over naive retrieval, production guardrails (fallback, length caps, PII scrubbing, tracing), and explicit adopt/avoid criteria — everything needed to decide and implement.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — change what gets embedded at query time — carries the whole note; guardrails and criteria are elaborations of it, not separate concepts.
